ranked.headline: Network priors and graph learning are being used to link omics data to cancer phenotypes
ranked.summary: Network-structured models now predict clinical outcomes and metabolic states from omics data, adding explainability and uncertainty quantification.

ranked.headline: Histology anchors cross-modal alignment of pathology, omics, and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Histology-anchored and foundation-model approaches now link whole-slide images, RNA-seq, and spatial omics within single-cell integration workflows.

ranked.headline: Model-based inference of cell identity and transcript assignment from single-cell imaging
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair learned models with barcoded lineage and multiplexed imaging readouts to resolve single-cell identity and function.

ranked.headline: Harmonized open-source software makes heterogeneous omics and imaging data searchable
ranked.summary: Recent R, Python and GUI releases pair harmonized data access with open-source delivery and, in one case, formal benchmarking of analysis tools.

ranked.headline: ML methods annotate protein function, plant effectors, viral taxa and eDNA sequences
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks and ensemble or zero-shot models are emerging as ML approaches for sequence-based annotation across biological domains.

ranked.headline: Selection and inductive structure improve data efficiency in biological sequence models
ranked.summary: Scale-only pretraining is costly, so recent items test pruning, efficient architectures, and encoded biological structure as alternatives.

ranked.headline: Genome content and defense turnover track lifestyle and selection across taxa
ranked.summary: Recent work links genomic compartments, defense turnover and lifestyle to genome evolution across bacteria, phages and fungi.

ranked.headline: Reusable models link selection, vector diversion, and spillover risk to epidemiological…
ranked.summary: Recent mechanistic models tie parameter inference to vaccine introduction, arbovirus host diversion, and spillover surveillance decisions.

ranked.headline: Cell geometry is being used to infer single-cell mechanics and behavior
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published method treat cell shape, junction topology, and tissue geometry as explicit inputs to single-cell force and behavior inference.

ranked.headline: Graph and attention models predict molecular and cellular interactions across scales
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs graph structure with sequence, language-model, or spatial features to model drug, microbe, and cell interactions.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and deep architectures advance molecular binding affinity prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair deep architectures with physics features, multimodal inputs, and active learning for affinity prediction.

ranked.headline: Task-specific ML models coupling encodings to endpoints in drug response prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple molecular and perturbation encodings directly to named endpoints such as viability, dependency, and ADME.

ranked.headline: Explicit interaction structure in microbial models: competition, treatment, alignment
ranked.summary: Spatial cross-diffusion and optimal control keep explicit microbial interaction structure analyzable across competition, eradication, and expansion.

ranked.headline: Explicit structure and physics anchor functional readouts in brain simulation
ranked.summary: Resolved neuronal geometry, stimulation physics, and fMRI-based whole-brain models now link biophysical structure to functional readouts across scales.

ranked.headline: Joint RNA-chromatin contacts and factor ordering infer regulatory architecture
ranked.summary: Multi-layer contact and factor profiling now allows regulatory architecture to be inferred beyond single readouts across distinct cell systems.

ranked.headline: Assembled genomes resolve fungal isochore architecture and plant taxane pathway origins
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies now anchor comparative analyses of fungal genome architecture and plant specialized-metabolism pathways.

ranked.headline: Computational methods tested at their reliability limits across proteins and membranes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published ML/MM study probe where AlphaFold3, MD, and NMR-based approaches remain reliable.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for designing, modeling, and analyzing experimental biology data
ranked.summary: Recent December 2025 releases provide open-source tools spanning plate design, impedance analysis, metabolic modeling, and drug combination screening.

ranked.headline: Truth sets and complete references target variant calling accuracy in hard regions
ranked.summary: New benchmark resources and complete reference genomes address variant calling accuracy in subclonal, repetitive and disease-associated loci.

ranked.headline: slideimp adds sliding-window K-NN and PCA imputation for DNA methylation arrays
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target missing values and quality control in high-dimensional genomic and epigenomic data, with open tooling for scalable preprocessing.

ranked.headline: Model-based gene selection and cross-dataset label transfer for single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed gene selection or label transfer within single modeling frameworks for scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: MD and coarse-grained models link conformational plasticity to nucleic acid binding
ranked.summary: Atomistic and coarse-grained simulations now resolve how surface charge, sequence and domain plasticity govern biomolecular binding.

ranked.headline: Deep learning assigns BGC products and predicts enzyme kinetic parameters
ranked.summary: Four December 2025 items pair learned sequence models with kinetic and literature data for biosynthetic and metabolic prediction.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell profiling resolves cell identity and state within intact tissue
ranked.summary: Spatial measurement now extends to genome-wide methylation and poly(A) isoform layers, alongside new segmentation and benchmarking advances.

ranked.headline: Deep learning maps RNA modifications from direct nanopore reads at single-molecule…
ranked.summary: Direct RNA nanopore sequencing now pairs with ML models to detect m6A, pseudouridine, m5C and structural modifications per molecule.

ranked.headline: Two-population Kuramoto model reproduces avalanche scaling in neuronal cultures
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study model how coupling, inhibition and gating shape which dynamical regimes neural and synthetic circuits can occupy.

ranked.headline: Scoring predicted protein structures against binding and experimental criteria
ranked.summary: Ensemble docking, electronic descriptors, and agentic design now score predicted structures against binding and experimental references.

ranked.headline: Simulators and physical priors constrain learned models of biological patterns
ranked.summary: Learned models now embed simulation, symmetry, and view statistics as modeling constraints for shape and pattern generation.

ranked.headline: Learned dynamics models infer cell states and therapy responses from indirect data
ranked.summary: Sparse and single-cell measurements now support explicit parameterization of cell-state and treatment dynamics in cancer and stem cell models.

ranked.headline: Learned and consensus models augment virtual screening for kinase and helicase inhibitors
ranked.summary: Iterative deep learning and consensus interaction models now yield micromolar to submicromolar inhibitors from virtual screens.

ranked.headline: PDE models couple immune, infection, and mechanical dynamics across biological scales
ranked.summary: Spatial PDE frameworks now link within-host kinetics, immunotherapy response, and cell mechanics to patient-specific data.

ranked.headline: Computational inference for proteoforms, glycan traits, and deeper DIA proteome coverage
ranked.summary: Imputation-aware proteoform discovery, glycan trait extraction, and narrow-window DIA-TMTpro workflows now pair statistical rigor with depth.

ranked.headline: Computational detection of cryptic exons and population exon variability from RNA-seq
ranked.summary: CRYPTID-exon and a 57,271-exon GTEx catalog offer new computational routes to exon boundary and splicing variation analysis from RNA-seq.

ranked.headline: Markov-chain formulations of promoter and Boolean network state-transition dynamics
ranked.summary: Explicit Markov state accounting is now tied to measured dwell times and attractor structure in regulatory models.

ranked.headline: Spatial indexing speeds complex alignment and interaction fingerprint detection
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package spatial indexing for large molecular ensembles and macromolecular complex alignment.

ranked.headline: Linking omics and entity networks to literature evidence via retrieval and LLMs
ranked.summary: Recent tools couple omics and biomedical entity data with literature retrieval and LLMs, making evidence traceability a central design question.

ranked.headline: Admixture, selection and demography shape association power and adaptive variation
ranked.summary: Pangenome assemblies and admixture-aware simulations show that population history shapes variant discovery and fine-mapping for complex traits.
